Steps (design basis; the company's 'designed annual production capacity' equals the table's annualised effective capacity: 4.2 GWh at end-2020 and end-2021 = 2.281 + 1.958 = 4.239, S1): 2019 = 2.3 (Jan-2019 lines, S2; CONFLICT: T099's Jiemian 2023-12-18 quote said phase-1 line 3 GWh; the company's own table is used and 2.3 replaces 3); 2020 = 4.2 (S1; Jul-2020 lines add 1.958; only Wenzhou existed then, Jiashan lines began May 2022); 2022 = 26.4 = REPORTED SUM, my arithmetic: Wenzhou subtotal effective capacity for H1 2023 13,205 MWh (six months, S3) x 2 = 26.41 GWh/yr, all Wenzhou lines having commenced by Sep 2022; cross-check: company designed 35.2 GWh at 2022-end/Jun-2023 (S1) minus Jiashan 4,404 MWh x 2 = 8.8 GWh (prospectus Jiashan subtotal, not quoted) = 26.4, which also matches the '26 GWh phases 1+2 built' MarkLines figure in T007.
